Text: Voice agents get harder to reason about when every intent, tool, and instruction sits inside one agent. This repo shows two concrete ways to split the work.

OpenAI Realtime Agents is a Next.js and TypeScript demo app for builders prototyping multi-agent voice experiences with OpenAI’s Realtime API and Agents SDK.

It helps you study and adapt voice-agent architectures by providing runnable chat-supervisor and sequential-handoff examples, plus configurable agent instructions, tools, and handoff graphs.

Key features:
• Chat-supervisor pattern – pairs a realtime chat agent with a text-based supervisor for tool calls and complex responses
• Sequential handoffs – routes users among specialist realtime agents through an explicitly defined agent graph
• Ready-made scenarios – includes simple handoff, retail customer service, and chat-supervisor configurations
• Inspectable interface – shows transcripts, tool activity, agent changes, and client/server events
• Output guardrails – checks assistant messages against moderation categories before displaying them

It’s open-source (MIT license).
